frequency_question: How often do substantive decisions to activate or raise a countercyclical capital buffer successfully satisfy formal institutional and publication criteria without technical defect?
membership_rule: Includes any formal regulatory adjustment of the countercyclical capital buffer above zero; excludes general capital requirement discussions not resulting in a formal CCyB rate change.

cases.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB activation 2019

coverage_note: 9 named instances covering major implementations; perfect compliance with formal announcement criteria once the policy action is decided.
known_gaps: Minor emerging market jurisdictions excluded due to differing central bank transparency standards.
skeleton: Global G10 central bank macroprudential announcements meeting formal publication criteria divided by total announced policy adjustments.
multiplier: 9 hits out of 9 total formalized implementation attempts across G10 jurisdictions with operational CCyB frameworks.
validity_reason: Central bank communication standards and official press release procedures are stable institutional features.
